blocks.text: אַתָּה גִּבּוֹר לְעוֹלָם אֲדֹנָי מְחַיֵּה מֵתִים אַתָּה רַב לְהוֹשִׁיעַ. מְכַלְכֵּל חַיִּים בְּחֶסֶד מְחַיֵּה מֵתִים בְּרַחֲמִים רַבִּים סוֹמֵךְ נוֹפְלִים וְרוֹפֵא חוֹלִים וּמַתִּיר אֲסוּרִים וּמְקַיֵּם אֱמוּנָתוֹ לִישֵׁנֵי עָפָר. מִי כָמוֹךָ בַּעַל גְּבוּרוֹת וּמִי דּוֹמֶה לָּךְ מֶלֶךְ מֵמִית וּמְחַיֶּה וּמַצְמִיחַ יְשׁוּעָה:
סוגרים הארון.
ע״ס תשר״ק.
ק׳

תֵּפֶן בְּמָכוֹן לְכֵס שֶׁבֶת. שְׁעוֹן וּמוּסָר כְּעָלוֹ בְּמַחֲשֶׁבֶת. רָם תְּהִי אָזְנְךָ קַשֶּׁבֶת. קוֹל שׁוֹפָר שְׁעוֹת מִנּוֹשָׁבֶת: צָרַת אֹמֶר לֹא יָדוֹן. פַּעֲמַיִם לֹא תָקוּם לַאֲבַדּוֹן. עוֹלָם אֲשֶׁר בְּאַרְבָּעָה נִדּוֹן. סְמוֹךְ בְּחַסְדְּךָ וּבַאֲמִתְּךָ אָדוֹן: נוֹעָדִים כְּיוֹם קְרָב וְנִלְחָמִים. מוּל אֶבֶן נֶגֶף מִתְלַחֲמִים. לִיבַב תְּרוּעָתָם שְׁעֵה מִמְּרוֹמִים. כִּסֵּא דִין לְהָמִיר בְּשֶׁל רַחֲמִים: יָחִיד אֲשֶׁר בְּעֵקֶד נִשְׁפָּט. טְלָאָיו יְחֻנָּנוּ מִלְּהִשָּׁפֵט. חָלִילָה לְּךָ אֱלֹהֵי הַמִּשְׁפָּט. זְכוֹר לֹא יַעֲשֶׂה מִשְׁפָּט: וְאִם כְּאָדָם עָבְרוּ בְרִית. הָאֵל כְּאֵל הַבֵּט לַבְּרִית.
ח׳
עוֹלָם בְּבַקֶּרְךָ בְּרֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה. בְּהַכְרָעַת צֶדֶק תַּכְרִיעַ (כ״י תַּעֲטֹר) שָׁנָה.
ח׳
אֲסוּמָה טְלוּלָה גְּשׁוּמָה אִם שְׁחוּנָה. אֲטוּמִים לְהַחֲיוֹת בְּטַלְלֵי שֵׁנָה (כ״י שָׁנָה):
Thou art forever mighty, O Lord, the reviver of the dead, Thou art great to save.

Sustaining life with kindness, reviving the dead with great compassion, supporting the falling, healing the sick, and releasing captives and keeping His faith with those who sleep in the dust. Who is like Thee, Master of might, and who resembles Thee, O King, who slays and revives and causes salvation to spring forth.

When Thou in heaven turnest to the throne with the intent to warn and to chastise, then may Thine ear, Exalted One, listen to the sound of the Shofar that rises up from the earth. The punishment of that sentence no longer to dispute (with the generations of man before the flood) will not return to cause havoc; as for the world which four days each year is judged, support it in Thy grace and in Thy truth, O Lord. For battle are we gathered, against the stone of offence (evil inclination) do we battle; listen from the heights to the plaintive sound of the Teruah, exchanging the throne of judgment for the throne of compassion. May the descendants of that only son who was summoned for sacrifice, be treated leniently in the course of justice; remember that plea: Far be it from Thee, O God of justice, not to administer justice. Though they as human beings have transgressed the Covenant, do Thou, as God, regard the Covenant; remove the threat of punishment of the Covenant since Thou rememberest the Covenant with the three forefathers.

When Thou dost examine the world on the day of the New Year, determine the year favourably, rich in fruit, dew and rain in the heat, so as to awaken to life from the grave through the dew of the year.
פותחים הארון.
ח׳
מִי כָמוֹךָ אַב הָרַחֲמִים. זוֹכֵר יְצוּרָיו לַחַיִּים בְּרַחֲמִים. וְנֶאֱמָן אַתָּה לְהַחֲיוֹת מֵתִים. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ מְחַיֵּה הַמֵּתִים:
סוגרים הארון.
ע״ס א״ת ב״ש.
ק׳

אַף אֹרַח מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ יְיָ קִוִּינוּךָ. תַּאֲוַת לֵב בַּצַּר פְּקַדְנוּךָ. בָּרֵי לֵבָב מֵאֶתְמוֹל קִדַּמְנוּךָ. שׁוֹפַר תְּרוּעָה טֶרֶם שִׁמַּעֲנוּךָ: גְּזֵרָה חַקֹּתָ מִיצִירַת בְּרֵאשִׁית. רֹאשׁ דְּבָרְךָ תְּשׁוּבָה לְהָשִׁית. דִּין טֶרֶם הֶעֱרַךְ מֵרֵאשִׁית. קָדְמָה לְמַלֵּט שׁוֹבָבִים מֵחֲרִישִׁית: הַיּוֹצֵר יַחַד שְׁנֵי לְבָבֵיהֶם. צוֹפֶה וּמַבִּיט שַׂרְעַף קִרְבֵיהֶם. וְאִם אָוֶן נִרְאָה בְּמַחֲבוֹאֵיהֶם. פָּקוֹד תִּפְקוֹד לָמוֹ קְרוֹבֵיהֶם: זְכֹר הֲסָרַת שֶׁכֶם מִסֵּבֶל. עֶבֶד כְּהָחְפַּשׁ מֵעִנּוּי כֶּבֶל. חֲנִיטָיו אִם תְּעַתְעוּ בְּתֵבֵל. שִׂיחוֹ יְחוֹנְנֵם לְחַיֵּי הֶבֶל: טְמִינַת לֵב וְנִקְמַת קֵץ. נִדָּחִים לֶאֱסוֹף בּוֹ בְּקֵץ. יוֹם מוּכָן עִתִּים לְהָקֵץ. מִיָּמִים יָמִימָה וּמִקֵּץ לְקֵץ: כַּסֵּא לְהַקְפּוֹרַת חֹדֶשׁ לִקּוֹב. כְּסוּחִים בְּלַהֲטוֹ לְהַבְהֵב לִרְקוֹב.
Who is like Thee, Father of compassion who remembers His creatures for life in compassion; and Thou art faithful to revive the dead. Blessed art Thou, O Lord, who revives the dead.

Even on the path of Thy judgments, O Lord, we trust in Thee; O Thou, longing of our heart, in adversity we search for Thee; pure of heart, we appeared already yesterday before Thee, even before sounding the tone of the Shofar. By decree didst Thou decide from the original creation to appoint repentance as the first of Thy pronouncements; even before the first judgment was arranged, repentance was already there to save sinners from destruction. Thou who hast formed their two instincts together and seest and knowest their innermost thoughts, should a sin appear within their hiding places, Thou wilt surely bear their great ancestors in mind for them. Remember him (Joseph) whose shoulder Thou didst relieve from the burden, who as a slave, was freed from the affliction of fetters; though his offspring have erred through lust, may his purity save them in this life of vanity. As for the day hidden in Thy heart and the retribution at the end of days, bring about the gathering of the exiles, the day prepared for the end of seasons, that is awaited from year to year, from time to time. Reveal the hidden day, decide the month for the severed thorns (sinners) to be burnt and disappear, for the stumbling block to be removed from the crooked heart and for Abraham, Isaac and Jacob to be remembered.
The Lord will reign for ever, your God, O Zion, from generation to generation. Halleluyah.
And Thou, O Holy One, art enthroned above the songs of praise of Israel, O God.
קו״ח
אֵל אֱמוּנָה בְּעָרְכְּךָ דִין. אִם תְּמַצֶּה עֹמֶק הַדִּין. מִי יִצְדַּק לְפָנֶיךָ בַּדִּין. קָדוֹשׁ:
קו״ח
אִם לֹא לְמַעֲנוֹ יַעַשׂ. וְיָסִיר מֶנּוּ חֲרוֹן אַף וָכַעַשׂ. אֵין לְבַקֵּר וְלִמְצוֹא מַעַשׂ. קָדוֹשׁ:
כוונת הפייטן להזכיר כי מאדם הראשון עד יאשיהו איש לא עמד זכאי בדין, ומזה יבינו כל יצורי חלד, אם בצדיקים דקדק הקב״ה כן ברשעים על אחת כמה וכמה. ושהמ״ח בראשי החרוזים אלעזר בירבי קליר.
ק׳

אָמֵץ אַדִּירֵי כָל חֵפֶץ. בְּהִתְבַּקְּרָם בַּדִּין חֻיְּבוּ לְנַפֵּץ. כְּלֹא נִמְצָא בָהֶם חֵפֶץ: אָדָם יְצִיר עָפָר מֵאֲדָמָה. לְאֵילֵי מָרוֹם אוֹתוֹ דִמָּה. לֹא בָן וּלְהֶבֶל דָּמָה: לַעֲבוֹד וּלְשָׁמוֹר גַּן הִפְרִישׁוֹ. וְעָבַר עַל צִוּוּיוֹ וַיְגָרְשׁוֹ. וְיוֹם זֶה לְיֹשֶׁר דְּרָשׁוֹ: לְעֵת הֵעִיר אֶזְרָח מִמַּאֲפֵל. עוֹלָם הָיָה תֹהוּ וּמְאֻפָּל. עֶשְׂרִים דּוֹר בָּזוּי וְשָׁפָל: עִקְּשִׁים בְּאֹרַח מִישׁוֹר מַסְלוּל יִדַּע. וְעַל נָאֳמוֹ בַּמָּה אֵדַע. נִדּוֹן בְּכֵן יָדֹעַ תֵּדַע: עוֹבְרִים בְּעֵמֶק הַבָּכָא לְהִבָּדֵק. אִם כְּפָעֳלָם בָּרִיב יְדַקְדֵּק. לִפְנֵי שׁוֹפֵט מִי יִצְטַדָּק: זָךְ הַמַּשְׁלִים בָּעֵקֶד נֶפֶשׁ. בַּזֹּקֶן לֹא מָצָא נֹפֶשׁ. וַתִּכְהֶיןָ עֵינָיו בְּעֶשֶׁן טִפֵּשׁ: זַרְעוֹ רֶגֶל בְּאָהֳלֵי תוֹרָה. וְעַל אָמְרוֹ דַרְכִּי נִסְתָּרָה. נִכְסָה מֶנּוּ פּוֹרָת בִּסְתִירָה: רָשָׁע אֲשֶׁר בַּמַּחֲבָּא יַחְתֹּר. צֶדֶק לְפָנָיו יַהֲלֹךְ וְיִנָּתֵר. אוּלַי בְּיוֹם אַף יִסָּתֵר: רֵעִים שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר כְּהִבְדִּיק. בָּרִיב אוֹתָם לֹא הִצְדִּיק. עַל מִכְרָם בַּכֶּסֶף צַדִּיק: בְּנֵי בְלִי שֵׁם בְּמִכְרָם עֲמוּסִים. בְּזוֹנָה וּבְיַיִן וּבְשׁוֹד חֲמָסִים. אֵיךְ בַּדִּין יִהְיוּ נֶעֱמָסִים: בְּהִתְיַצְּבוֹ לָרִיב
God of faith, when Thou dost order justice and dost penetrate the depth of justice, who can then be justified before Thee in justice, O Holy One.
If He does not act for His own sake and remove wrath and anger, it is futile for us to search and find actions, O Holy One.

Those who resolutely subdue their desire, they too were found guilty when examined in justice as though no delight had been found in them. The first man formed from the dust of the earth, who was comparable to the heavenly angels, failed to understand and he became like a mere shadow. To till and care for the garden had God set him apart; when he transgressed His commandment, then He drove him away; but this day became his intercessor. When He awoke that radiant one (Abraham) from the dark, the world had been empty and dark, after twenty generations despised and dejected; though he showed the straight and even path to those who had strayed, yet since he himself said ‘how shall I know’, it was decreed against him ‘you shall surely know’ (the sufferings of your descendants). As for those who pass through the valley of tears to be tested, when the Lord judges the case according to their deeds, who will then be justified before the Judge? The pure one who offered his life as a sacrifice (Isaac), did not find comfort in his old age, for his eyes became dim through the idolatrous smoke of the fool (Esau). He who trained his children in the tents of the Torah (Jacob), since he said ‘My way is hidden’, his offspring (Joseph) was long concealed from him. The wicked man who plots in secret, drives away justice and rejects it, can he hide himself on the day of wrath? When the Lord tested the twelve brothers, He did not pronounce them just, for they had sold the righteous one for silver. The sons of the nameless (Chaldeans), who sold Israel for lechery, wine and violent plunder, how heavy will be their burden when brought to Justice. When the Lord arises to strive, when He

בְּעָמְדוֹ לַדִּין. עַל זֹאת אוֹתָם יָדִין. לְמַעַן יֵדְעוּן שֶׁהוּן בַּדִּין: יֶרֶד אֲשֶׁר הוֹרִיד אֲמָרִים. וְהִדְרִיךְ בְּכוֹר שׁוֹר מֵחֲמוֹרִים. וְנֶעֱנַשׁ בְּשִׁמְעוּ נָא הַמֹּרִים: יַעַן אֲשֶׁר נוּקַשׁ בֶּעֶשֶׂר. נֶחֶרְתוּ בוֹ מִיתוֹת עֶשֶׂר. וּכְגָע גְבוּל נִכְבַּל בֶּאֱסוֹר: רָאשֶׁיהָ אֲשֶׁר בַּשֹּׁחַד יִשְׁפּוֹטוּ. אֵיךְ בְּכֵן צֶדֶק יִשְׁפּוֹטוּ. כִּי אִם כְּמוֹ שָׁפָטוּ: רוֹבִים עֲלֵי אֵשׁ זָרָה. פָּגְעָה בָם בְּאַף גְּזֵרָה. לְלַמֵּד בָּם פּוֹשְׁעֵי פְזוּרָה: בַּעַר חָמַד מִן הַחֵרֶם. וְנִלְכַּד הוּא וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר לוֹ בַּחֵרֶם. מִגָּדִישׁ וְעַד קָמָה וָכֶרֶם: בּוֹגֵד וְשׁוֹדֵד מַה מּוֹעִיל. הוֹן בְּעֶבְרָה לֹא יוֹעִיל. כִּי אִם לְחַלּוֹת פְּנֵי מְלַמֵּד לְהוֹעִיל: יָד שָׁלַח אֱחוֹז בָּאָרוֹן. נַעֲשָׂה בוֹ מִשְׁפָּט וְחָרוֹן. מַה יַּעֲשׂוּ עוֹבְרֵי כִּבְנֵי מָרוֹן: יוֹדֵעַ נַגֵּן כְּפָץ בְּחָנֵנִי. נִבְחַן וְנָם חִנָּם חָנֵּנִי. וְאַל תָּבֹא בְמִשְׁפָּט לְדַיְּנֵנִי: קוֹרְאֵי בְגָרוֹן וְקוֹל שׁוֹפָר. אִם פִּשְׁעָם בַּדִּין יִסָּפֵר. בְּמַתְּנַת חִנָּם הַיּוֹם יְכֻפַּר: קָצִין כְּגָאָה לְקַטֵּר לַשֵּׁם. נֶגַע בְּמִצְחוֹ זָרַח לְהֵרָשֵׁם. וְנִשְׁפַּט בְּלֹא יָדַע וְאָשֵׁם: לְעֵת תִּמּוֹט רֶגֶל זֵדִים. אֲשֶׁר בָּאוּ לְהֵיכַל מְזִידִים. יִשָּׁפְטוּ בְּמַכְנִיעַ זֵדִים: לְעֵת יִבָּקְרוּ פֹּעֲלֵי שֶׁקֶר. לְהִשָּׁפֵט בְּוִכּוּחַ אַף וְחֵקֶר. יִסָּכֵר פִּי דוֹבְרֵי שָׁקֶר: יָשָׁר מִתְהַלֵּךְ לְפָנָיו בֶּאֱמֶת. אֵיךְ אַחֲרֵי הַדְּבָרִים וְהָאֱמֶת. חִשַּׁב פָּעֳלוֹ אֱלֹהִים אֱמֶת: יְדִיד אֲשֶׁר לְפָנָיו וְאַחֲרָיו. לֹא קָם כָּמֹהוּ בִּבְחִירָיו. וְאַחֲרֵי כָל זֹאת דִּקְדֵּק אַחֲרָיו: יָבִינוּ כָל יְצוּרֵי אָרֶץ. אִם כֵּן בִּמְצוּקֵי אָרֶץ. מַה יַּעֲשׂוּ רִשְׁעֵי אָרֶץ: רָאֹה יִרְאוּ יַעֲרֵי שִׂיחָם.

stands upright for justice, for this He will condemn them, that they may know judgment in justice. Yered (Moses), who brought the words of God from Sinai, who led the firstborn (Israel) out from among the Egyptians, he too was punished when he said: ‘Listen, you rebels’. For Israel’s trial of the Lord ten times he shared the penalty, his death was announced to him ten times; and when he reached the border of the Holy Land he was restrained. Judges, when they judge through bribery, how can they expect to be judged with charity? As they have judged others, so shall it be done to them. The youths (Nadab and Abihu) who offered up strange fire, suffered the decree of wrath as a warning to evil doers among the dispersed people (Israel). The fool desired what was banned, he too was caught within the ban with all that was his, the heaps of corn, the standing corn and vineyard. What avail his deeds to the faithless and the robber, substance avails not on the day of wrath, only entreaty before Him whose teaching avails. He (Usha) stretched out his hand to grasp the Holy Ark, and judgment and wrath overtook him; what shall they do who pass before Him like lambs? When the skilled player on the harp (David) said, ‘Test me’, he was tested; but then he said, ‘Since I am without merit, be lenient with me, do not come in judgment to judge me’. They who call out aloud and blow the Shofar, when their misdeeds are counted in judgment, as an undeserved gift let them be atoned this day. The prince (Uzziah), when he dared to bring incense to the Lord, was marked on the forehead with distinct leprosy and so was he judged for unwitting transgression. When there falters the foot of the proud, who arrogantly entered the Sanctuary, they too will come to be judged by Him who humbles the proud. When those who act falsely come to be tested, with angry argument and question to be judged, then the mouth of those who speak falsehood, will be silenced. The upright (Hezekiah) walked before Him in truth, yet after his good deeds and his truth, the God of truth condemned one of his deeds. The favourite (Josiah) whom none among the chosen of the Lord resembled before or after, was yet severely judged by the Lord. So let all creatures on earth understand, since such was the fate of pillars of the earth, what are the sinners on earth to do. Let them look at

אִם אֵשׁ אָחֲזָה בַּלַּחִים. אָז יָנוּעוּ יְבֵשִׁים כְּסוּחִים: רְאֵה כִּי אֵין אִישׁ. לְהַפְגִּיעַ בְּעַד בְּנֵי אִישׁ. וְאַתָּה אֵל וְלֹא אִישׁ: רָשׁוּם בִּכְתַב אֱמֶת אֲשַׁנֶּה. מַעֲשֵׂה כָּל יְמוֹת הַשָּׁנָה. לְרַצּוֹתְךָ בְּשׁוֹפַר (אם שבת בְּזִכְרוֹן שׁוֹפַר) בְּזֶה רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה:
ח׳
וּבְכֵן וַיְהִי בִישֻׁרוּן מֶלֶךְ: (כ״י וּבְכֵן נַמְלִיכְךָ מֶלֶךְ עֶלְיוֹן:)
חזן.
פותחים הארון.
מֶלֶךְ עֶלְיוֹן. אֵל דָּר בַּמָּרוֹם. אַדִּיר בַּמָּרוֹם. אֹמֶץ יָדוֹ תָּרוּם. לַעֲדֵי עַד יִמְלוֹךְ:
מֶלֶךְ עֶלְיוֹן. גִּבּוֹר לְהָקִים. גּוֹזֵר וּמֵקִים. גּוֹלֶה עֲמוּקִים. לַעֲדֵי עַד יִמְלוֹךְ:
מֶלֶךְ עֶלְיוֹן. הַמְדַבֵּר בִּצְדָקָה. הַלּוֹבֵשׁ צְדָקָה. הַמַּאֲזִין צְעָקָה. לַעֲדֵי עַד יִמְלוֹךְ:
מֶלֶךְ עֶלְיוֹן. זוֹכֵר צוּרִים. זַכּוֹת יְצוּרִים. זוֹעֵם צָרִים. לַעֲדֵי עַד יִמְלוֹךְ:
מֶלֶךְ עֶלְיוֹן. טוֹב שׁוֹכֵן עַד. טוּבוֹ לָעַד. טֹפֵחַ שְׁמֵי עַד. לַעֲדֵי עַד יִמְלוֹךְ:
מֶלֶךְ עֶלְיוֹן. כַּשַּׂלְמָה עוֹטֶה אוֹר. כָּל מְאוֹרֵי אוֹר. כַּבִּיר וְנָאוֹר. לַעֲדֵי עַד יִמְלוֹךְ:
מֶלֶךְ עֶלְיוֹן. מֶלֶךְ עוֹלָמִים. מְפַעֲנֵחַ נֶעֱלָמִים. מֵשִׂיחַ אִלְּמִים. לַעֲדֵי עַד יִמְלוֹךְ:

the dense forests; when the fire reaches the fresh trunks, then let the dry and severed ones tremble. Behold there is no man to entreat on behalf of the children of man, but Thou art God and not a man. Let me repeat what is inscribed in the script of truth, the work of all the days of the year, in order to appease Thee with the Shofar sound (the memory of the Shofar) on this day of the New Year.
And thus was He King in Yeshurun (Therefore let us crown Thee, Supreme King.)
Supreme King. God dwells on high, He is mighty on high, the might of His hand is high, He will reign forever.
Supreme King. Strong to fulfil, decreeing and fulfilling, revealing the deep, He will reign forever.
Supreme King. Speaking in righteousness, clothed in righteousness, listening to complaints, He will reign forever.
Supreme King. Remembering the rocks (forefathers) to justify their descendants, angry with their enemies, He will reign forever.
Supreme King. Benevolent, everlasting, His kindness is everlasting, He spreads out the heavens everlasting, He will reign forever.
Supreme King. Draped in light as in a gown, He gives light of all lights, mighty and luminous, He will reign forever.
Supreme King. King of eternity, revealing secrets, making the dumb speak, He will reign forever.
מֶלֶךְ עֶלְיוֹן. סוֹבֵל הַכֹּל. סַב וּמְבַלֶּה כֹּל. סוֹקֵר הַכֹּל. לַעֲדֵי עַד יִמְלוֹךְ:
מֶלֶךְ עֶלְיוֹן. פָּאֳרוֹ עֹז. פֹּעַל יְמִינוֹ הָעֹז. פּוֹדֶה וּמָעוֹז. לַעֲדֵי עַד יִמְלוֹךְ:
מֶלֶךְ עֶלְיוֹן. קְדוֹשָׁיו לַהַב. קוֹרֵא מֵי רַהַב. קָרוֹב לְקוֹרְאָיו בָּאֹהַב. לַעֲדֵי עַד יִמְלוֹךְ:
מֶלֶךְ עֶלְיוֹן. שֵׁנָה אֵין לְפָנָיו. שֶׁקֶט בְּפַנִּינָיו. שֶׁבַח טוּב בְּמַצְפֻּנָּיו. לַעֲדֵי עַד יִמְלוֹךְ:
מֶלֶךְ עֶלְיוֹן. תָּקְפּוֹ לָעַד. תִּפְאַרְתּוֹ עֲדֵי עַד. תְּהִלָּתוֹ עוֹמֶדֶת לָעַד. לַעֲדֵי עַד יִמְלוֹךְ:
קו״ח
סוגרים הארון.
וּבְכֵן לְךָ תַעֲלֶה קְדֻשָּׁה. כִּי אַתָּה אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ:
חזן.
קהל בעטעט ביז מעבירין את רוע הגזרה.

וּנְתַנֶּה תֹּקֶף קְדֻשַּׁת הַיּוֹם. כִּי הוּא נוֹרָא וְאָיוֹם. וּבוֹ תִּנָּשֵׂא מַלְכוּתֶךָ. וְיִכּוֹן בְּחֶסֶד כִּסְאֶךָ. וְתֵשֵׁב עָלָיו בֶּאֱמֶת. אֱמֶת. כִּי אַתָּה הוּא דַיָּן וּמוֹכִיחַ וְיוֹדֵעַ וָעֵד. וְכוֹתֵב וְחוֹתֵם וְסוֹפֵר וּמוֹנֶה. וְתִזְכּוֹר כָּל הַנִּשְׁכָּחוֹת. וְתִפְתַּח אֶת סֵפֶר הַזִּכְרוֹנוֹת. וּמֵאֵלָיו יִקָּרֵא. וְחוֹתַם יַד כָּל אָדָם בּוֹ. וּבְשׁוֹפָר גָּדוֹל יִתָּקַע. וְקוֹל דְּמָמָה דַקָּה יִשָּׁמַע. וּמַלְאָכִים יֵחָפֵזוּן. וְחִיל וּרְעָדָה יֹאחֵזוּן וְיֹאמְרוּ הִנֵּה
Supreme King. Enduring all, ancient and outliving all, investigating all, He will reign forever.
Supreme King. His splendour is strength, the work of His right hand is strong, He delivers and is a refuge, He will reign forever.
Supreme King. His saints are a flame, He summons the ocean’s waters, He is near those who call Him in love, He will reign forever.
Supreme King. There is no sleep before Him, yet His treasures enjoy calm, there is high praise in His treasuries, He will reign forever.
Supreme King. His might is eternal, His glory is eternal, His fame endures forever, He will reign forever.
And therefore to Thee let holiness ascend for Thou art our God, O King.

Let us tell of the might of this day’s holiness since it is full of dread and awe. On it Thy Kingdom is exalted and Thy throne made firm with grace and in truth dost Thou sit upon it. It is true that Thou art He who judges and reproves and knows and witnesses and writes and seals and counts and reckons. Thou dost remember all things that are forgotten and Thou dost open the book of memories and it is read out of its own accord and the seal of every man’s hand is on it. Then there is a blast on the great Shofar and a soft and slender sound is heard. The angels hasten to and fro and are seized with trembling and dread so that they say: ‘Behold it is the day of judgment and the host on high

יוֹם הַדִּין. לִפְקוֹד עַל צְבָא מָרוֹם בַּדִּין. כִּי לֹא יִזְכּוּ בְּעֵינֶיךָ בַּדִּין. וְכָל בָּאֵי עוֹלָם תַּעֲבִיר (כ״י יַעַבְרוּן) לְפָנֶיךָ כִּבְנֵי מָרוֹן. כְּבַקָּרַת רוֹעֶה עֶדְרוֹ. מַעֲבִיר צֹאנוֹ תַּחַת שִׁבְטוֹ. כֵּן תַּעֲבִיר וְתִסְפּוֹר וְתִמְנֶה. וְתִפְקוֹד נֶפֶשׁ כָּל חָי. וְתַחְתּוֹךְ קִצְבָה לְכָל בְּרִיָּה. וְתִכְתּוֹב אֶת גְּזַר דִּינָם: בְּרֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה יִכָּתֵבוּן. וּבְיוֹם (צוֹם) כִּפּוּר יֵחָתֵמוּן. כַּמָּה יַעַבְרוּן. וְכַמָּה יִבָּרֵאוּן. מִי יִחְיֶה. וּמִי יָמוּת. מִי בְקִצּוֹ. וּמִי לֹא בְקִצּוֹ. מִי בָאֵשׁ. וּמִי בַמַּיִם. מִי בַחֶרֶב. (וּמִי בְחַיָּה.) וּמִי בָרָעָב. (וּמִי בַצָּמָא.) וּמִי בָרַעַשׁ. וּמִי בַמַּגֵּפָה. (וּמִי בַחֲנִיקָה וּמִי בִסְקִילָה.) מִי יָנוּחַ. וּמִי יָנוּעַ. מִי יִשָּׁקֵט. וּמִי יִטָּרֵף. מִי יִשָּׁלֵו. וּמִי יִתְיַסַּר. מִי יָרוּם (כ״י יָרוּם.) וּמִי יִשָּׁפֵל. מִי יֵעָשֵׁר. וּמִי יֵעָנִי:
חזן
וּתְשׁוּבָה וּתְפִלָּה וּצְדָקָה מַעֲבִירִין אֶת רוֹעַ הַגְּזֵרָה:
צום קול ממון
קהל בעטעט ביז ושמנו קראת בשמך.

כִּי כְשִׁמְךָ כֵּן תְּהִלָּתֶךָ. קָשֶׁה לִכְעוֹס וְנוֹחַ לִרְצוֹת. כִּי לֹא תַחְפֹּץ בְּמוֹת הַמֵּת. כִּי אִם בְּשׁוּבוֹ מִדַּרְכּוֹ וְחָיָה. וְעַד יוֹם מוֹתוֹ תְּחַכֶּה לּוֹ. אִם יָשׁוּב מִיָּד תְּקַבְּלוֹ: אֱמֶת. כִּי אַתָּה הוּא יוֹצְרָם. וְיוֹדֵעַ יִצְרָם. כִּי הֵם בָּשָׂר וָדָם: אָדָם

is to be considered in judgment’ for they have no merit in Thine eyes in judgment. Then Thou dost cause all who come into the world to pass before Thee like lambs. Just as a shepherd controlling his herd makes his flock pass beneath his staff, so dost Thou cause to pass, count, reckon and consider every living soul and Thou dost appoint a limit for every creature and inscribe their verdict.

On the New Year they are inscribed and on the Day of Atonement they are sealed, how many shall pass away and how many shall be born, who shall live and who shall die, who at his proper time and who before his time, who by fire and who by water, who by the sword and who by hunger, who by the storm and who by the plague, who shall have rest and who unrest, who shall find repose and who shall be harassed, who shall be calm and who chastised, who raised high and who laid low, who enriched and who impoverished.
Yet Penitence, Prayer and Charity avert the disaster of the decree.

For as Thy Name so is Thy fame. Hard to anger and light to appease, Thou dost not desire the death of the man condemned to death, but that he should turn back from his way and live; until the day of his death dost Thou wait for him, should he repent, Thou wilt at once receive him. But Thou art King, O God, living and enduring

There is no limit to Thy years and no end to the length of Thy days, one cannot measure the chariots of Thy glory nor fathom the mystery of Thy Name; Thy Name is fitting for Thee and Thou art fitting for Thy Name and our name hast Thou called by Thy Name. Act for Thy Name’s sake and sanctify Thy Name upon those who sanctify Thy Name.

According to the mystic utterance of the holy Seraphim, who sanctify Thy Name in holiness, those who dwell above and those who dwell below, proclaim three times the threefold sanctification in sanctity, as it is written through Thy prophet, once calls to the other and says:
‘Holy, Holy, Holy is the Lord of Hosts, the whole earth is full of His glory’.
His glory fills the world, His servants ask one of the other: ‘Where is the site of His glory?’ Those opposite them say: ‘Blessed . . .’.
